versions.notes: demo mode (--demo): a drawn camping scene where a person, a dog or a bear walks by now and then - alarm, recording, diary, deterrence work as with a real camera; own settings folder, "DEMO" in the header, nothing that changes the computer (shutdown, Wi-Fi, updates, passwords ...). For trying it out or an online demo.

MQTT / Home Assistant (System & network): state, events and the alarm picture to an MQTT broker, commands back (arm / disarm, lights, snapshot); Home Assistant discovery (alarm panel, person / motion / animal / recording, battery, temperature, camera picture). Own small MQTT client (no extra package), optional TLS.

several devices: Cameras page -> "Other Motion Watch devices": picture, armed / alarm, battery, last event of every device (home network or Tailscale), arm / disarm one or all, search in the network, own password per device.

sharing with a small logo: animal diary pictures, snapshots, recordings and timelapse videos (new share button in the recordings viewer) and the night report picture get a discreet strip "Motion Watch" + what / when (switch: Recording -> "Shared pictures and videos with a small Motion Watch logo").

targeted deterrence (Light & sound -> Deterrence): own reaction for person, big animal, small animal, warm body - sound (new: high whistle, bangs / claps, or own sound files) and / or the white light flashing; duration, pause, also when disarmed (garden).

theft protection (Alarm & camping): sabotage alarm when the camera is covered or turned away (picture check, pauses while the head moves itself), optional motion sensor MPU-6050 (I2C 0x68: moved / knocked over), power cut while armed = alarm; when armed an urgent push with picture + siren.

backup (Recordings -> Backup): finished alarm recordings are copied away from the device - WebDAV (Nextcloud, NAS, cloud), a folder (USB stick / NAS) or Telegram (video); one folder per day, waits for the sound, 3 tries, test button.

web push: alarm messages straight into the browser / home screen app (no ntfy app needed): Notifications -> "Switch on on this device", test; needs https - button "https over Tailscale" (tailscale serve, real certificate); iPhone / iPad from the home screen app. Standard Web Push (VAPID + aes128gcm) with python3-cryptography.

setup assistant at the first start (web page): language + device name, push messages (ntfy topic with QR code and test message), web password, QR codes of all addresses; System -> "Setup assistant" / "Quick start (QR)": printable card with QR codes (own Wi-Fi of the Pi to join, page addresses). Window: QR codes for the phone at the first start and under Setup. Own QR encoder (no extra package).

signed updates: every version in versions.json is signed with the developer's secret key (Ed25519, kept offline); only signed versions are offered and installed (update bar, automatic update, list shows signed / not signed). Setting "Also accept unsigned versions" for own builds. --make-manifest DIR --sign-key FILE signs.
phone too: "Expand all / Collapse all" as two symbols right of the settings search (no more big buttons).

new app icon: orange tile with the white camera head (pan / tilt fork); one icon and one name «Motion Watch» for every address (no more green / red, «MW Intern / Extern») - one Tailscale link works at home and away.
the reload button (app mode) first looks for a new version, then reloads the page - a new version shows right away in the update bar.
tablet / computer: "Expand all / Collapse all" are two small symbols right of the settings search (phone unchanged); window: small symbol buttons too.
no more zooming in when a text field is tapped on iPad / iPhone (fields 16 px on touch screens); the two scrolling columns on the tablet can no longer be pushed sideways.

header no longer flickers: badges are shortened in the same step as they are filled (before, the long texts showed for a moment and the line wrapped); on tablet/PC the badge line never wraps (scrolls sideways if ever too long).
tablet/PC header: status badges in their own line below the tabs, title/tabs/buttons no longer jump.

tidier header on tablet/PC: status badges on the right next to the buttons (separated by a line), all header buttons the same size with drawn icons (bell, reload, menu, full screen) instead of characters, equal heights.
update list shows only about three versions, the rest scrolls (web page and window).

automatic update (Updates: "Install new versions automatically", hour, also when armed): installs the newest version in the chosen hour when nothing is going on, push before; start guard: a new version that does not start 3 times is replaced by the previous one again
statistics tiles under the picture (FPS, persons now, objects, detections) and the object list removed - web page and window (the values are still in the header and the event log)

compact header: armed / disarmed big (red and pulsing at an alarm), values in their normal range (no person, CPU, FPS, Wi-Fi, microphone ...) behind one "✓ all ok" chip (tap = show them), short symbols (⏱ 4′, 🌙, 🍃 …), theme / language / settings panel / hide header moved into the ☰ menu, header shrinks to one line when scrolling down

Waveshare UPS HAT (INA219 on I2C 0x42, 2 x 18650 in series): found by itself, battery % from the cell voltage, time left from the measured power, mains / battery / charging in the header, push + log at a power cut and when the power is back, warning at 20 %, clean shutdown at 8 % (adjustable); powerbank estimate stays for devices without UPS

event log card: at least 10 lines (important ones, filled up pale with the newest others), also right after a restart (taken from the log file); log page: "← Back to the live picture"; automatic update check (2 min after the start, then every 3 hours): bar "New version … – Update now" on the page, badge in the window, one push message
updates: always the newest version list (GitHub's file server kept an old copy for up to 5 minutes), the list shows when it was searched and from when the list is; versions with date and time

the event log card shows only the important entries (alarms, persons, animals, recordings, arming, problems, remote access, restarts ...) with small icons; the log page has the filter "Important only"; everything stays in the file
phone: the page could become wider than the screen (zoomed out, header only half as wide) when a list held a long entry - now every list / field / log line stays inside the screen width

event log: status line every 15 min (CPU, temperature, FPS, camera, Wi-Fi, internet, memory, voltage, battery), daily archive (logs/motionwatch_YYYY-MM-DD.log.gz, kept 60 days, also when a file grows over 20 MB), new page /log ("Whole log & archive": filter by kind, search, 300 / 1000 / 5000 lines, download every day); the card shows 40 entries

operator mode (System -> "Operator mode (lock settings)", window: Setup): settings locked with a PIN (4-8 digits, hash); the operator can still arm / disarm, use the camping profile, the main switches (detection, recording, notifications, power saving, patrol, timelapse ...), lights, camera, listen / talk, recordings; the web server refuses everything else (HTTP 423), the window shows only the operator panel; 5 wrong PINs = 5 minutes pause
small 🎧 button next to the stick / buttons (row "Control") switches listening to the microphone on and off; green and pulsing while listening

in low light the visible picture is brightened too (gamma curve, adapts to the darkness; switch under Detection -> Low light) - before, a dark scene looked black while the detection still marked movements; autostart more robust after a power cut: restarts after any exit and never gives up (Restart=always, StartLimitIntervalSec=0), start without login (linger) is checked at every start and switched on or explained

updates from a private GitHub repository: new secret field "GitHub key (token)" (read-only token; only sent to GitHub addresses, never shown or logged); clear hint when the repository is private and no key is set

recordings page: timelapse videos appear in the list (marked ⏱), new type filter "Timelapse" shows the videos and all single photos; play, download, star (starred photos are kept), delete, ZIP work as for recordings
tablet / computer (wider than 960 px): settings column and picture column scroll separately - the live picture always stays in view
internet check also over normal web traffic (port 443, first the push server itself) - no more false "no internet" when a router blocks port 53 to outside servers
home screen icon depends on the address: green "MW Intern" (home network / hotspot), red "MW Extern" (Tailscale 100.x / *.ts.net) - two shortcuts can be told apart
app mode (home screen icon): reload button ⟳ in the header; every page shows "New version running - Reload" after an update

pause the program (System & network -> System, window: Setup): switches off at once (recording finished, settings saved) and starts again by itself after 5 min ... 12 h; meanwhile a small page with countdown and "Start now" (same process: autostart and watchdog keep working)
web: search box above the settings - typing hides every group / section / field without the words (German or English), matches are framed and opened; ✕ / Esc shows everything again

animal diary (tab "Diary": best picture of every animal visit, filter, favourites, share), night report (push in the morning with what happened at night + best picture), privacy zones (painted black right after the camera, also in recordings / for guests), guest access (view-only link /g/<key>, time limit, can be ended at once), app icon for the phone home screen (manifest, icons), powerbank runtime estimate (capacity, "battery full", header badge, warning at 15 %)
phone: direction buttons centred like the stick; German texts in Swiss spelling (ss instead of sharp s)

live picture reconnects by itself when the phone loses the stream (no more "?" icon, spinning ↻ meanwhile), also when coming back to the browser; phone full screen upright: stick right under the picture
web full screen: the buttons "expand all / collapse all" are hidden (phone held sideways)

remote access (Tailscale): header badge "🌐 Remote: <device>" while somebody watches from outside, Tailscale status + address under System, log entries, optional push message, new relay trigger "remote access" (also when disarmed) e.g. for a small warning lamp

web full screen button works on phones: the video fills the screen (real full screen on Android / PC, page layout on iPhone / iPad where browsers allow no full screen), round ✕ button top right to go back
a failed camera switch (the old camera keeps running) shows a yellow "switch failed" note for one minute instead of a red badge that stayed until restart; red only when no camera works at all
first version on GitHub (updates from github.com/<user>/motionwatch); older program files are recognised by their real version number in the update list

MANUAL on the web page (tab "Manual", /help): quick start, all functions, tips & tricks, troubleshooting, setup; search, table of contents, printable, German / English; button "Manual" in the desktop window

header tidied up: status first (armed, persons, recording), then what is switched on (camping, power saving, timelapse, lights, thermal camera, patrol, own Wi-Fi, schedule, relays, microphone), then warnings, then CPU / FPS; things in their normal state (no rain, calm wind, light ok, source connected ...) are not shown any more

UPDATES: choose a version (newer or older) and switch with one tap; source = versions.json on the internet (e.g. GitHub) or a folder (USB stick); checked before it starts (checksum, Python, version); older versions stay for going back
Bluetooth loudspeaker also on the "Cameras" page (search, connect, test sound); the version stands next to the name at the top left (all pages and the window)

started by hand while the autostart copy (maybe an older version) runs: the copy is stopped and this program takes over its web page (before, the page silently stayed the old one); the version is shown on the page; pages are never cached
BLUETOOTH loudspeaker: search, pair + connect from the page / window, used for siren, test sound and talking; reconnects by itself when the speaker comes back

settings tidied up: 9 groups (new: "Light & sound"), inside a group every topic opens / closes the same way (the first one is open), fine-tuning at the end under its own line, power saving has its own topic; web page and window alike

under-voltage warning (power bank / cable, Pi 5 shows the input voltage); memory card: free space shown, push message and the oldest recordings are deleted when it gets full; watchdog (autostart restarts a hanging program, --allow-wifi switches the hardware watchdog on); settings export / import; web password can be set on the page / in the window (asked at the first visit, stored as a hash)

POWER SAVING mode: while all is quiet only a few pictures per second (camera itself slower), full speed at once at any movement, noise, alarm, recording, manual control or while somebody watches; part of the camping profile, schedulable

hardware of the 3D-printed pan/tilt head: servos on a PCA9685 (I2C, address selectable, no jitter on the Pi 5), pan / tilt limits in degrees; LIGHTS white + infrared (PCA9685 channel or GPIO, Off / On / Auto: at an alarm or the whole night by sunset); grey picture at night (NoIR camera); Waveshare Thermal-90 (SPI, pysenxor) as thermal camera with zoom / shift to match the camera picture; the noise alarm ignores the servo motors; push message when the Pi gets too hot
TALK from the phone through the loudspeaker of the Pi (hold the button); a second, secure page (https, port + 1) starts by itself, because phones only allow their microphone on https pages

POWER: shut down / restart the Pi from the page and the window (recording is finished first, settings saved). AUDIO: choose microphone + loudspeaker; noise alarm (louder than the background, push + browser + relay trigger "noise" + recording), live listening in the browser, sound in the recordings, siren / own sounds on the Pi at an alarm

own texts for the push messages (title + text for person, pre-alarm, thermal alarm, device name) with placeholders {name} {time} {date} {count} {camera} {link}; umlauts / emoji work with ntfy (RFC 2047)
the desktop window uses the same 8 groups as the web page

web page: the 26 menus are now 8 groups (Alarm & camping, Notifications, Detection, Camera & servos, Recordings & timelapse, Thermal camera, Relays & schedule, System & network); fine tuning under "Advanced"; more compact

NETWORK AUTOMATIC: known networks first (phone hotspot = internet + push), otherwise the own Wi-Fi; when the phone hotspot disappears the own Wi-Fi comes on, and every 10 min (only if no device is connected) it looks again
AUTOSTART switch: on = at boot Motion Watch starts by itself (systemd, no screen needed) and switches the own Wi-Fi on; off = nothing starts at boot and the Pi joins its known networks

CAMPING - own Wi-Fi of the Pi (hotspot, works without mobile network) with one switch; ARMED / DISARMED with countdown (alarms, push, browser sound, relays, recordings only while armed); THERMAL ALARM (warm body moving in the zones: relay trigger, push, sound, recording); the clock of the Pi is taken from the phone when there is no internet time; CAMPING PROFILE: own Wi-Fi + camera stays still + alarms on + armed after the countdown (switching off restores)
